_doc: Free official regulation feeds polled by regwatch/watch.py. Backbone is free + official (no vendor dependency). Paid RegTech is reserved for gap jurisdictions only. See regwatch/README.md.

feeds.name: EUR-Lex CELLAR
feeds.format: SPARQL + REST (content negotiation: RDF/XML, JSON-LD, Notice)
feeds.coverage: EU legal corpus, ~2.7M works (regulations, directives, decisions, case-law, treaties)

feeds.name: FederalRegister.gov
feeds.coverage: US Federal Register: final rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents

feeds.name: eCFR
feeds.coverage: US Code of Federal Regulations, current and point-in-time historical

feeds.name: regulations.gov
feeds.auth: key (free; DEMO_KEY usable for light/testing use)
feeds.coverage: US rulemaking dockets, regulatory documents, and public comments

feeds.name: IOSCO publications
feeds.coverage: International Organization of Securities Commissions: standards, reports, consultation papers

feeds.name: BIS publications
feeds.coverage: Bank for International Settlements: Basel Committee standards, working papers, guidance

paid_regtech_gap_only.name: Thomson Reuters Regulatory Intelligence
paid_regtech_gap_only.note: Reserved for gap jurisdictions the free feeds do not cover. Not part of the free backbone.

paid_regtech_gap_only.name: Corlytics
paid_regtech_gap_only.note: Reserved for gap jurisdictions the free feeds do not cover. Not part of the free backbone.
